# AwakeProd

> AwakeProd is the trade name of Julien Raulot, an independent developer in France who makes iPhone apps.

## Molette

Molette is an iPhone music player for your own files, with a clicking wheel like a 2000s pocket player.
- Plays MP3, AAC, M4A, ALAC, FLAC, WAV, AIFF and CAF, gapless, offline.
- No account, no server, no ads, no data collected. Music is copied in with Finder, Apple Devices on Windows, or the Files app.
- Free for the first 25 albums. Unlimited is a one-time in-app purchase (not a subscription): every album, Clean Up Names, seven colored cases, a Home Screen widget.
- iOS 17 or later. Interface in 15 languages.
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6834086865
- [Molette (English)](https://www.awakeprod.fr/molette/): features and FAQ
- [Molette (français)](https://www.awakeprod.fr/molette/fr/)
- [Support](https://www.awakeprod.fr/molette/support/): adding music, formats, restoring a purchase
- [Privacy](https://www.awakeprod.fr/molette/privacy/): Molette collects no data
